fact_text: The National Gemstone Policy 2026-30 was approved by the federal government and aims to formalise Pakistan's gemstone sector.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Much of Pakistan's gemstone mining and trade runs informally, so the policy puts registration and traceability of businesses at the centre of its approach.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Exporting cut and polished stones instead of rough material is meant to capture more value from Pakistan's gemstone reserves.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The gemstone policy plans to modernise mining machinery, set up demonstration mines and ease access to the controlled explosives used in mining.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The gemstone policy plans to expand cutting and polishing facilities, fund skill programmes and simplify imports of rough stones for local processing.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The gemstone policy targets annual gemstone exports of about $500 million by 2030, a level far above the sector's current official export base.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A committee set up by the prime minister in September 2025 recommended the reforms that were folded into the gemstone policy.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Official gemstone exports are very small relative to Pakistan's estimated gemstone reserves, which points to a formalisation and processing gap rather than a shortage of resources.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Sales tax on hybrid vehicles is tiered by engine size, and under the earlier auto policy it was 8.5% or 12.75% depending on the engine.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When the auto policy 2026 expired on 30 June, the sales tax on hybrid vehicles rose to 25%, well above the earlier concessional rates.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A draft auto policy covering 2026 to 2031 has been reviewed by a Senate standing committee.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Petrol dealers are paid a fixed margin per litre, and they have pushed for a percentage-based margin instead.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Petrol dealers want a formal role in shaping the operating rules that govern oil marketing companies and their dealer networks.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Petrol pump prices are now revised daily, so moves in international prices pass through to retail buyers quickly.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: PSO is the only company permitted to import high-speed diesel in FY2027, after the federal cabinet barred private oil marketing companies from diesel imports.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Private oil marketing companies can import petrol only with OGRA approval, and their allowed volumes are tied to their market share over prior months.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Allocating import volumes by past market share favours incumbents and rewards existing share rather than new entrants.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Restricting diesel imports to PSO shifts import volume toward PSO, which could support its sales volumes if the restriction holds.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A sudden drop in pipeline pressure is how PSO detected an illegal tapping, allowing it to alert enforcement agencies and intercept the thieves on the spot.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: US tariffs on a country's exports raise the cost of its goods in the US market, which tends to reduce export volumes and hurt exporters in the affected country.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A bilateral exchange stabilisation facility would add to official reserves, ease rupee pressure and reduce reliance on multilateral borrowing, per the analyst's reasoning.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A sovereign rating upgrade lowers the risk premium lenders charge, which cuts interest rates on international borrowing and letter of credit confirmation charges.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan's current account moved to a deficit of about $139 million in FY2026, from a surplus of about $1.83 billion in FY2025.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Workers' remittances reached about $41.5 billion in FY2026, up about $3.3 billion from FY2025.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Imports were about $76.4 billion in FY2026, leaving a trade deficit of roughly $35.5 billion that remittances largely covered.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Remittances are the main buffer that keeps the current account manageable when the trade deficit widens, so oil-driven import costs are the key pressure point.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Foreign direct investment fell about 34% to $1.637 billion in FY2026, from $2.47 billion in FY2025.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Chinese foreign direct investment into Pakistan was about $862 million in FY2026, down from roughly $1.2 billion in FY2025.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The Tasdeeq Information Services IPO, cleared by SECP with its prospectus issued, is described as the first IPO of FY2027.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Tasdeeq Information Services holds a credit bureau licence from the State Bank and maintains borrowers' credit data and ratings for lenders.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst expects a positive market reception for the Tasdeeq IPO, judging by the general investor interest in recent IPOs.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistani equities have been driven more by Gulf geopolitics and oil prices than by improving domestic macro data, according to the analyst's reading of the market.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A Gulf conflict that disrupts oil shipping lifts oil prices, which raises Pakistan's import bill, pressures the current account and weighs on investor sentiment.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, '2000 Liter Petrol Theft, First IPO of 2027, $10 Billion Fund! Shafy's Weekly Roundup.' (YouTube transcript, undated)
